string-array.name: streak_lines_none
string-array.item: No flame yet. Finish an episode or a chapter to light it.
Your streak is a blank page. One episode changes that.
Cold in here. Let\'s get a fire going.
Zero days. The only way is up.

string-array.name: streak_lines_day1
string-array.item: Day one. Every legend starts somewhere.
The first spark. Don\'t let it go out.
One day down. Your couch is proud already.

string-array.name: streak_lines_early
string-array.item: Three in a row. Your couch noticed.
It\'s becoming a habit. Dangerous.
Look at you, being all consistent.
The flame is growing. Keep feeding it.

string-array.name: streak_lines_week
string-array.item: A whole week! Touch grass? Nah, one more episode.
Seven days. Your watchlist is getting nervous.
You\'re on fire. Literally, check the icon.

string-array.name: streak_lines_fortnight
string-array.item: Two weeks strong. Sleep is optional now.
This is no longer a streak, it\'s a lifestyle.
Your dedication is showing. So is your screen time.

string-array.name: streak_lines_month
string-array.item: 30 days. Your watchlist is shaking.
The buttons are on fire. Not our fault, it\'s you.
A month of flames. Respect.

string-array.name: streak_lines_legend
string-array.item: Absolute legend. Even the cat is impressed.
At this point the flame has its own gravity.
You are the main character. The streak proves it.
Unstoppable. Please hydrate.

string-array.name: streak_lines_at_risk
string-array.item: Your flame is flickering. One episode saves it.
Nothing yet today. The fire is getting hungry.
Quick, a chapter or an episode before the flame dies.
Streak at risk. This is not a drill.

string-array.name: streak_lines_grace
string-array.item: You missed yesterday, but a grace day has your back.
Grace day on standby. Finish something to keep the flame.
Close call. Your weekly grace day is ready to save you.

string-array.name: streak_lines_lost
string-array.item: Streak extinguished. We don\'t talk about it.
The flame went out. Fresh start, though.
It happens to the best of us. Light it again.
Fresh start. The cat forgives you.
